meta.name: remove-ai-slops
meta.description: Removes AI-generated code smells from branch changes or an explicit file list behind regression tests. Use when the user asks to clean up, deslop, or remove AI-slop patterns from recent changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 清理代码中AI生成的坏味道与冗余痕迹
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常担心AI助手留下的代码不够干净
copy.tagline_en: Clean up AI-generated code smells and redundant patterns in your recent changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often worry about messy code left by AI assistants

howto.what: 装上后它会先给改动的文件补回归测试锁住行为，再按 9 类 AI 味（多余注释、过度防御、死代码等）分批清理，最后跑 lint、类型检查等质量门禁，验证失败就回退。
howto.when: 当你要求清理、deslop 或去掉最近改动里的 AI 生成痕迹时接管；默认范围是当前分支相对 main 的 diff，也可由调用方传入指定文件列表。

say.text: 把当前分支改动的 AI 味清一遍
say.note: 先补测试锁行为，再清理并跑质量门禁

say.text: 帮我 deslop src/foo.py 和 src/bar.py
say.note: 这两个文件即为清理范围

say.text: 清理前先确认这些改动有回归测试覆盖
say.note: 没覆盖会先补最窄的回归测试

howto.what_en: It pins the changed files' behavior with regression tests, runs a categorized multi-pass cleanup of AI slop (obvious comments, over-defensive code, dead code, etc.), then verifies with lint/typecheck and reverts on failure.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to clean up, deslop, or remove AI-slop patterns from recent changes; default scope is the branch diff vs main, or an explicit file list.

say_en.text: Deslop the changes on my current branch
say_en.note: Locks tests first, then runs quality gates

say_en.text: Run deslop on src/foo.py and src/bar.py
say_en.note: Those files become the cleanup scope

say_en.text: Check these changes have regression coverage first
say_en.note: Adds the narrowest test if missing
